snippet.title: 900 - Trailer | Steam, iOS, Android
snippet.description:
900 is a circular swiping game for Android, iOS, Windows, Mac and Linux in which the player controls an entity that must absorb universes in order to grow endlessly.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/696860/900/
iOS: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/900/id1222649459?mt=8
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.barnaque.neufcent&hl=en_US
Itch: https://barnaque.itch.io/900
---
